pretreatments.description: Deflocculation using TiO2 embedded chitosan thin film (TCTF) under solar radiation to remove exopolymer aggregates (EPS) and microbial cell aggregates from sludge.
Enzyme secreting bacterial disintegration using Bacillus strains (Bacillus jerish 03 and 04) incubation at 40°C, pH 6.5, and 42h to promote solubilization of particulate organics.
